name: Hasty Rebirth
body:
So powerfully bound are you to your phylactery that you do not long linger before you are rejuvenated.

Prerequisites: Lich.

Benefits: You rejuvenate in just one day.

Normal: A lich takes 1d10 days to rejuvenate.

Way of the Wicked Book Five — The Devil My Only Master. Copyright 2012, Fire Mountain Games LLC; Author: Gary McBride.
